BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Shea, Taylor, G. Hunt, Scott, Griffey, Rodne, MacEwen, Young, Haler, Short, and Buys
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Repealing background check provisions for gun sales and transfers relating to Initiative Measure No. 594.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to criminal and public safety background checks for gun sales and transfers; repealing RCW 9.41.092, 9.41.113, 9.41.115, 9.41.137, and 82.08.833; repealing 2015 c ss 2, 5, 6, 7, and 11; and repealing 2015 c 1 s 1 (uncodified).

BillSectionHeader.P: The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:

BillSection.P: 1RCW 9.41.092 (Licensed dealer deliveries—Background checks) and 2015 c 1 s 4 (Initiative Measure No. 594);
2RCW 9.41.113 (Firearm sales or transfers—Background checks—Requirements—Exceptions) and 2015 c 1 s 3 (Initiative Measure No. 594);
3RCW 9.41.115 (Penalties—Violations of RCW 9.41.113) and 2015 c 1 s 9 (Initiative Measure No. 594);
4RCW 9.41.137 (Department of licensing, authority to adopt rules—Reporting of violations—Authority to revoke licenses) and 2015 c 1 s 8 (Initiative Measure No. 594);
5RCW 82.08.833 (Exemptions—Sales or transfers of firearms—Unlicensed persons—Background check requirements) and 2015 c 1 s 10 (Initiative Measure No. 594);
